EN: Rescue the missing Vault Dweller.
ZH: 拯救失踪的避难所居民。

EN: Track down missing sleuth Bisgby Brown.
ZH: 追查失踪的侦探比格斯比·布朗。

EN: If you're here for that detective, you're gonna have to go through us first!
ZH: 如果你们来这是为了那个侦探，得先过我们这一关！

EN: Oh look. Another snack for our pets. Tenderize 'em!
ZH: 哦快看呐，我们的宠物又有零食可以吃了。给我煮了他们！

EN: The Book of Wuv
ZH: 恋爱之书

EN: Let's get down and dirty!
ZH: 我们来比一比谁的手段更肮脏！

EN: Let's clean this dirtbag's clock!
ZH: 让我们狠狠揍这个混球一顿！

EN: Vault Dweller filth! You'll pay for what you did to my brother!
ZH: 避难所居民的败类！你们会为对我哥哥做的事付出代价！

EN: Let's mop the floor with this scrub!
ZH: 让我们把这个杂碎打趴下！

EN: Few Raiders play dirtier than the two Raider bosses known as the Brothers Grime. Teach these black-hearted sibling scoundrels a lesson.
ZH: 很少有掠夺者的手段会比两个称之为“污秽兄弟”的掠夺者首领更肮脏。给这对黑心的兄弟无赖一点颜色瞧瞧。

EN: The Brothers Grime
ZH: “污秽兄弟”

EN: Kill the Brothers Grime.
ZH: 消灭“污秽兄弟”二人。

EN: Kill the Brothers Grime.
ZH: 消灭“污秽兄弟”二人。

EN: Confront a dastardly pair of Raider siblings.
ZH: 对抗一对卑劣的掠夺者兄弟。

EN: Hey, to each their own.
ZH: 嘿，各有所好嘛。

EN: Likewise, smoothskin.
ZH: 你也一样，“光滑皮肤”们！

EN: Good luck! You'll need it!
ZH: 祝你好运！你会需要它的！

EN: Cause my daddy raised me right! Also, because I still have a fairly intact amygdala.
ZH: 因为我父亲把我养得好！还有，我的杏仁核还算完好。

EN: Vault Dwellers! Why you snoopin' around?
ZH: 避难所居民！你们在找什么？

EN: You're not looking for that purloined pooch by any chance, are you?
ZH: 你们不会在找那只被偷来的狗吧？

EN: Better hurry! The Ferals are about to feast!
ZH: 快点！狂尸鬼们准备开饭了！

EN: Raw dog. Disgusting. Now roasted cat... yum!
ZH: 生狗肉。真恶心。烤熟的猫肉……美味！

EN: Gross.
ZH: 恶心。

EN: Thanks for the heads up! You're not so bad... for a Ghoul.
ZH: 谢谢你的提醒！对于尸鬼来说……你还不算太坏。

EN: Yikes! Then there's no time to waste!
ZH: 哎呀！我们没时间可以浪费了！

EN: How come you're being, you know... reasonable?
ZH: 你是怎么做到……这么理智的？

EN: You've discovered some unsolved case files of the legendary Wasteland detective, Nick Valentine! First up - the case of the captured canine!
ZH: 尼克·瓦伦坦，是废土侦探界的传奇。他手上有一些未解决的案件档案，首先一个就是——被抓住的狗。

EN: The Case of the Captured Canine
ZH: 被抓住的狗

EN: Rescue the dog from the Feral Ghouls.
ZH: 从狂尸鬼手里拯救狗狗。

EN: Feral Ghouls have captured a canine! Rescue the potentially delicious doggie.
ZH: 狂尸鬼们抓住了狗狗！趁它被吃掉之前赶紧把它拯救出来。

EN: What? No! We didn't take nothing. I mean, look at this place. What's to steal? Now, please, go help my pal, huh?
ZH: 什么？没有！我们什么也没拿。我是说，你看看这地方，有什么可偷的？拜托，赶紧去帮帮我的伙伴，行吗？

EN: You will? Oh thank you! And sure, sure. I won't rob no one. Scout's honor. Heh.
ZH: 你会吗？哦太谢谢你了！当然，我不会抢劫任何人的。以童子军的荣誉起誓。嘿嘿。

EN: Does that mean you'll do it? Oh thank you! And yeah, here. This is all I got on me.
ZH: 就是说你会去做是吗？哦太谢谢你了！来拿着，这是我的全部家当。

EN: Wait. You ain't Nick. You here to help? The settlers snatched my, uh, business associate. Said they're going to kill him for stealing their food.
ZH: 等等。你不是尼克。你是来帮忙的？定居者抓走了我的……呃，生意伙伴。说他偷了他们的食物，要杀了他。

EN: But we didn't do nothing!
ZH: 但是我们什么都没做啊！

EN: If I go in there, they'll shoot me dead. Talk to 'em for me, will ya?
ZH: 如果我去的话，他们会杀了我的。能不能帮我去和他们谈谈？

EN: Tell me the truth and I'll consider helping. Did you steal from them?
ZH: 你先和我说实话我再考虑要不要帮你。你们到底有没有偷东西？

EN: I'll help, but only if you stop robbing people.
ZH: 我会帮忙，但你得保证不要再打劫别人了。

EN: I'm not doing it for free.
ZH: 我不会白帮忙的。

EN: You think I want to do this? But we're starving here! Look, you find our grub, maybe we could consider letting him loose.
ZH: 你以为我们想这样吗？我们在这里快饿死了！听着，如果你能找到我们的食物，我们可以考虑放了他。

EN: Woah! No need for that! But we're not letting that Raider go until we get our food back. You find it, then maybe we'll let him go.
ZH: 等等，我们不需要。但没有找到食物之前，我们是不会让那个掠夺者离开的。你要是找到了，我们可以放他走。

EN: Well if it wasn't that Raider, then who was it? Look, you find that food, then maybe we'll consider letting the Raider go.
ZH: 可是如果不是那个掠夺者的话会是谁呢？听着，你们要是能找到食物，我们会考虑放了他。

EN: You. If you're here to beg for that Raider's life, you're wasting your time. Just turn around and go.
ZH: 听着，如果你们来是为了让我们放了那个掠夺者，那你们还是省省吧。转身出门不送。

EN: That Raider needs to learn he can't steal our food and live.
ZH: 那个掠夺者要明白他是不可能拿了我们的食物还想活着出去的。

EN: Let the Raider go!
ZH: 放了那个掠夺者吧！

EN: Don't make me hurt you.
ZH: 不要让我伤害你们。

EN: How do you know he did it?
ZH: 你们怎么知道是他干的？

EN: You! You're here to help, right? Look, I didn't do it. Whatever stole their grub, it's living somewhere in the building. And it sounds mean! Please, help me out here!
ZH: 你！你是来这里帮忙的是吗？听着，不是我干的，不管是谁偷了他们的食物，一定是这栋楼里的生物。而且肯定不好对付！求求你们，快救我出去！

EN: Looks like these no good Radroaches stole that food! This ought to get that Raider off the hook!
ZH: 看起来像是辐射蟑螂偷了他们的食物！这应该能还那个掠夺者清白了。

EN: You uncovered a poorly written note among Nick's files, asking for his help in finding a kidnapped friend.
ZH: 你从尼克的档案里发现了一张字迹模糊的字条，上面请求他帮忙去寻找一位被绑架的朋友。

EN: The Case of the Lost Lunch
ZH: 消失的午餐

EN: Speak to the Raider.
ZH: 同掠夺者交谈。

EN: Speak to the settlers.
ZH: 同定居者交谈。

EN: Confront the thief.
ZH: 和窃贼对峙。

EN: Someone's been kidnapped! Help bring them home!
ZH: 有人被绑架了！救出他，带他回家吧！

EN: Fine. Whatever. So long as I get what's mine.
ZH: 好吧，随便你们，我只要我的东西。

EN: That's the spirit. Now get going. That mitt ain't going to return itself.
ZH: 就是要有这种态度。现在继续，手套可不会自己回来。

EN: Cause there ain't no one else around. Now, I ain't looking for an interrogation. I just want that mitt back. So go.
ZH: 因为附近也没有其他人。现在我不指望有什么审讯，我只想拿回我的手套。

EN: It's mine. That's what's special. And I won't have folks stealing from me. Now how about you hop to it, eh?
ZH: 那是我的，对我而言很特殊。我是不会让别人从我这里偷走它的。现在你们能开始调查了吗？

EN: Oh. You must be Nick's pal. Took ya long enough. You here to help me recover my great, great, great...
ZH: 哦，你们一定是尼克的朋友。等到你们可真不容易啊。你们来这里是为了帮我找回我曾曾曾曾……

EN: ...great grandpappy's mitt? Well, I'll make it easy for ya.
ZH: ……曾祖父的手套？也许这些信息能帮助你们。

EN: The culprit's hiding out in this place as we speak.
ZH: 我们说话的时候罪犯就藏在附近。

EN: That whippersnapper stole my mitt. How about you rough 'em up and get it back for me, huh?
ZH: 那个傲慢的家伙偷走了我的手套。你们能不能给他点颜色看看然后帮我拿回手套？

EN: What if I just talk to them instead? Ask for the mitt back?
ZH: 不如我直接和他们说说？让他们把手套还给你？

EN: Rough them up? Sounds like fun.
ZH: 给他们点颜色看看？听起来挺有意思的。

EN: How do you know it was this “whippersnapper”?
ZH: 你怎么知道就是那个“傲慢的家伙”？

EN: What's so special about this mitt?
ZH: 这个手套到底有什么特别的？

EN: Nope, but it didn't walk off on its own. Might be someone else around who snatched it.
ZH: 不是，但它肯定不可能自己跑掉了。也许是周围什么人偷偷顺走了。

EN: Hey, hey. Let's not do anything hasty here. I'll give you some of the other stuff I “recovered.” Now, don't you have a mitt to recover?
ZH: 嘿，先不要着急。我会给你们看看我“找回”的另外的东西。现在，你们能帮我找回手套了吗？

EN: Honestly? Guy just rubbed me the wrong way. Wanted to wipe that droopy grin off his face.
ZH: 说实话？那家伙就是惹毛了我，想把他那张傻笑的脸打烂。

EN: Whoa, whoa, whoa. Did Clarence send you? Look, I don't have his mitt.
ZH: 诶……诶？等等。是克拉伦斯派你们来的？他的手套不在我这。

EN: I mean, I did, but it's gone now.
ZH: 我的意思是，我曾经有，但现在没有了。

EN: It was stolen while I was sleeping.
ZH: 我睡觉的时候，手套被偷了。

EN: You want it back, you're going to have to find it yourself.
ZH: 你们想要手套的话，就得自己去找了。

EN: Any idea who might've taken it?
ZH: 你知道是谁拿的吗？

EN: Clarence suggested I rough you up. You want to give me a reason not to?
ZH: 克拉伦斯想让我给你点颜色看看。你能告诉我一个不这么做的理由吗？

EN: Why steal his mitt?
ZH: 为什么要偷他的手套？

EN: A note among Nick's files requested his help in recovering a lost family heirloom - a pre-war catcher's mitt with great sentimental value.
ZH: 尼克的档案里有一张字条，请求他帮忙找回一件遗失的传家宝——一只颇具纪念意义的战前捕手手套。

EN: The Case of the Missing Mitt
ZH: 丢失的手套

EN: Speak to Clarence.
ZH: 同克拉伦斯交谈。

EN: Confront the thief.
ZH: 和窃贼对峙。

EN: Recover the catcher's mitt.
ZH: 找回接球者的手套。

EN: Help an old Ghoul recover a precious family heirloom, would ya?
ZH: 帮助一个尸鬼找回一件珍贵的传家宝。

EN: Oh thank goodness. Last time anyone spotted it, it was further into the Vault. Please. Take care of that beast before it kills again!
ZH: 哦，谢天谢地！上次有人见到它时，它还在避难所更深处。拜托了，趁那头野兽还没再害人，赶紧把它解决掉！

EN: Seriously? Fine. Here. Just make sure you take care of that thing, okay?
ZH: 真的吗？好吧，来拿着。请务必解决掉那家伙，好吗？

EN: Well, I didn't get a good look at it, but I can tell you it's hideous. Three heads, quick as a shot. But most of all, it loves Quantum. Stole every last bottle we had!
ZH: 呃，我没仔细看过，但我可以告诉你它很难看。有三个头，速度超快。最重要的是，它超爱量子核子可乐。它偷走了我们所有的存货！

EN: D-did Nick send you? You've got to help us! The “Quantum Creeper”. It's been eating our people. We're all that's left.
ZH: 是，是尼克派你来的吗？你得救救我们！“量子爬行者”。它一直在吃我们的人。我们就剩这些人了。

EN: I can see its glow whenever I close my eyes.
ZH: 我只要一闭上眼睛就能看见它闪着光。

EN: Please! Get rid of that menace for us! I'm begging you!
ZH: 救救我们！帮我们除掉它！求求你了！

EN: That Creeper's toast!
ZH: 那个“爬行者”完蛋了！

EN: Are you going to make it worth my while?
ZH: 你们拿什么报答我呢？

EN: Tell me about the Creeper.
ZH: 和我讲讲这个“爬行者”。

EN: Wait!
ZH: 等等！

EN: There's blood here. And blue liquid. Quantum! This must be the right way!
ZH: 这里有血迹。还有蓝色液体。量子核子可乐！这一定是正确的路！

EN: Wait a minute. Are those... claw marks? They're... glowing. Must be getting close now.
ZH: 等等，这些是……爪印吗？他们正在……发光。应该就在附近。

EN: Nick was asked to solve the mystery of “The Quantum Creeper,” a beast that's been munching on the citizens of a local Vault and stealing their Quantum. What say you lend them a hand?
ZH: 有人请求尼克去解开“量子爬行者”的谜题。这个怪兽把当地的避难所居民吃掉并偷走他们的量子核子可乐。去帮他们一下怎么样？

EN: The Case of the Quantum Creeper
ZH: 量子爬行者

EN: Speak to the Vault Dwellers.
ZH: 同避难所居民交谈。

EN: Deal with “The Quantum Creeper.”
ZH: 解决“量子爬行者”问题

EN: Track down the Quantum Creeper.
ZH: 追踪“量子爬行者”。

EN: You'll die for that cheap crossover joke!
ZH: 你会为了那个廉价的跨界笑话而死去！

EN: No, don't! I'll stop stealing cats for my mother, I swear!
ZH: 不，不要！我发誓不再为我妈妈偷猫了！

EN: Well obviously the rule doesn't apply to me. Duh!
ZH: 很明显这个规则不适用于我。呸！

EN: Here, kitty kitty... Wait a minute, you're not a cat!
ZH: 来吧，小猫咪……等一下，你不是猫！

EN: This place is a designated human-free area.
ZH: 这个地方是指定的无人区。

EN: It's quite simple: four legs you live, two legs you die.
ZH: 很简单：四条腿就可以活，两条腿就得死。

EN: What if you lost a leg after taking an arrow to the knee?
ZH: 你觉得膝盖中一箭然后失去一条腿怎么样？

EN: Give it up or we'll drown this kitten.
ZH: 放弃吧，否则我们就淹死这只小猫。

EN: Okay, well, you got two legs, so you die.
ZH: 这个，你有两条腿，所以你死了。

EN: My eyesight is fine, dearie. Here, have a cookie.
ZH: 我的视力很好，亲爱的。来，吃饼干。

EN: Well, that would explain the lack of purring. Here, take this for your troubles.
ZH: 好吧，那就说明为什么没有呼噜声。来，拿这个解决你的烦恼。

EN: You've come to decorate your hats? Here, you can use this.
ZH: 你来装饰你的帽子？这里，你可以用这个。

EN: Is that you dearie?
ZH: 是你吗亲爱的？

EN: Did you bring me another little friend?
ZH: 你给我带来了另一个小朋友吗？

EN: How about a seeing-eye dog?
ZH: 一只导盲犬怎么样？

EN: You realize most of the animals here are Mole rats, right?
ZH: 你知道这里大多数动物都是鼹鼠吧？

EN: I'm sorry, we've come to take away your cats.
ZH: 对不起，我们来是要带走你的猫。

EN: A cat burglar has been hitting Vault after Vault, taking pets away from their owners. Stop them before they steal another cat!
ZH: 一个“飞贼”接连光顾一个个避难所，把宠物从主人身边偷走。趁他偷走下一只猫之前阻止他！

EN: The Cat Burglar
ZH: 偷猫贼

EN: Neuter the Cat Burglar.
ZH: 阉割偷猫贼。

EN: Solve the mystery of an elusive thief.
ZH: 解开一个难以捉摸的小偷的秘密。

EN: Smells like kitty litter... This must be the way.
ZH: 闻起来像猫砂……这条路一定是对的。

EN: Well, this is just purrrfect...
ZH: 这个，这只简直完美……

EN: Can't turn back meow!
ZH: 不能回头啊喵！

EN: I wouldn't mind a catnap right now.
ZH: 我不介意现在打瞌睡。

EN: It's a Vault simulator. We're calling it “Nuclear Bunker.”
ZH: 这是一个避难所模拟器。我们称之为“核掩体”

EN: We set out to do a spreadsheet, but we got sidetracked...
ZH: 我们准备做一个电子表格，但我们却分心了……

EN: Nah, your Pip-Boy is too old. Maybe you can try adding this expansion card...
ZH: 不，你的哔哔小子太旧了。也许你可以尝试添加这个扩展卡……

EN: Look, it's the De-Buggers! Are we happy to see you!
ZH: 看，这是除虫师们！很高兴见到你们！

EN: Radroaches keep frying the mainframe's circuits...
ZH: 辐射蟑螂们总是油炸主机的电路板……

EN: As a result, my list of objectives keeps resetting for no reason!
ZH: 因此，我的目标列表总是莫名其妙重置！

EN: How annoying is that?!
ZH: 那有多烦人？！

EN: What's your game about?
ZH: 你的游戏是关于什么的？

EN: Why are you guys wasting your time on a silly game?
ZH: 你们为什么要在无聊的游戏上浪费时间？

EN: Can I try your game?
ZH: 我可以试试你的游戏吗？

EN: Don't worry, you should be able to get a solid three minutes of play before that happens.
ZH: 别担心，在那之前你应该能得到三分钟的上场时间。

EN: As crazy as it sounds, some people will pay Caps to play games.
ZH: 听起来很疯狂，有些人会花瓶盖玩游戏。

EN: I'm a producer: I make sure we have fresh produce daily, so the team stays healthy.
ZH: 我是一个制片人：我确保我们每天都有新鲜的产品，所以团队能保持健康。

EN: Thank you for helping us meet our milestone.
ZH: 谢谢你帮助我们迎接我们的里程碑。

EN: That's a word we invented to gauge our progress.
ZH: 这是我们发明来衡量我们进步的一个词。

EN: When we meet an objective, we carve “Good Job!” on a slab of rock.
ZH: 当我们达到目标时，我们就刻下“干得漂亮”！在一块岩石上。

EN: We then crush the least productive team member under it.
ZH: 然后，我们会粉碎最低生产力的团队成员。

EN: Will this game drain my Pip-Boy battery?
ZH: 这个游戏会消耗我的哔哔小子电池吗？

EN: Shouldn't you be making useful stuff, like weapons?
ZH: 你难道不应该制造点有用的东西吗，比如武器这种？

EN: So, what's your role?
ZH: 那么，你的作用是什么？

EN: We've received a call for help from Vault 505. They've been working on a special project that would allow Dwellers to play games on their Pip-Boys. Imagine that! Unfortunately, they've also been overrun with Radroaches. We have to help them!
ZH: 我们接到了来自505号避难所的求助电话。他们一直在做一个特殊的项目，可以让居民们在他们的哔哔小子上玩游戏。想象一下！不幸的是，他们还被辐射蟑螂侵扰。我们必须帮助他们！

EN: The De-Buggers
ZH: 除虫师们

EN: Talk to the developers.
ZH: 与开发商交谈。

EN: Talk to the producers.
ZH: 与制作者交谈。

EN: Help Vault 505 deal with its bug problem.
ZH: 帮助505号避难所解决它们的虫患问题。

EN: Seems everytime I get rid of a bug, two more pop up...
ZH: 似乎每次我摆脱一个错误，就有两个新的弹出来……

EN: Who'd play games on portable electronic devices, anyway?
ZH: 谁会在便携式电子设备上玩游戏呢？

EN: Game over, man!
ZH: 游戏结束了，男人！

EN: Probably a trap. This place is crawling with Raiders. Good luck.
ZH: 大概是个陷阱。这个地方到处都是掠夺者。祝你们好运。

EN: Fine. This is probably just a Raider trap anyway.
ZH: 算了，这个也许只是一个掠夺者陷阱。

EN: Oh great, more Wastelanders.
ZH: 呵呵，太棒了，更多的废土居民。

EN: Let me guess, you're here for the Door Buster, too?
ZH: 让我猜猜，你们来这也是为了“破门神器”吧？

EN: Do you know what it is?
ZH: 你们知道那是什么吗？

EN: Back off, we were here first!
ZH: 靠边站！我们先来的！

EN: Across the Wasteland, rumors swirl of a treasure called the “Door Buster.” The race is on to claim this mysterious prize!
ZH: 废土上流传着一些关于“破门神器”的传说。抓紧时间看看谁能先抢到这件神秘的宝贝！

EN: The Door Buster
ZH: 破门神器

EN: Search for the Door Buster.
ZH: 寻找“破门神器”。

EN: Be the first to claim the Door Buster!
ZH: 成为第一个找到“破门神器”的人！

EN: Here for the Door Buster? Suckers! We just made that up.
ZH: 为了“破门神器”而来的吗？蠢蛋！那是我们编的。

EN: More Wasteland trash? It's like a stampede in here!
ZH: 更多的废土垃圾？一窝蜂全来了？

EN: No way was this worth it. Next time, I'm sleeping in!
ZH: 根本不值得。下次，我要睡懒觉！

EN: More people? Sheesh! These crowds are getting ridiculous!
ZH: 这么多人？嘘！这些人可真是搞笑！

EN: No, we're freelancers, killing for fun and profit.
ZH: 不，我们是自由职业者，为了乐趣和利润而杀人。

EN: Makes sense. All we found so far is this junk.
ZH: 有道理。到目前为止我们发现的都是垃圾。

EN: On that topic, do you believe in bullets?
ZH: 关于那个话题，你相信子弹吗？

EN: What do you want, Dwellers?
ZH: 你们想要什么，居民们？

EN: Don't tell me you're after Shaun's treasure too...
ZH: 不要告诉我你也想要尚恩的宝藏……

EN: There won't be much left by the time someone finds it!
ZH: 等有人发现它的时候恐怕不会有太多剩下的！

EN: We're not even sure it exists!
ZH: 我们甚至不确定它是否存在！

EN: Aren't you Shaun's muscle?
ZH: 你不是尚恩的肌肉吗？

EN: I heard the treasure's at the *other* end of the rainbow.
ZH: 我听说宝藏在彩虹的另一端。

EN: If we believe in it, then it exists in our hearts.
ZH: 如果我们相信它，那么它就存在于我们的心中。

EN: Hmm...when ya say it out loud it *does* sound a bit daft.
ZH: 嗯……当你大声说出来，这确实听起来有点疯狂。

EN: Aye, sure look it.
ZH: 是的，可不是嘛。

EN: I will yea, ya muppets!
ZH: 我会的，你们这些笨蛋！
